resources.string: You define the rules. The Door helps you keep them.
The Door helps you create barriers against distractions, content, and habits you want to avoid. Unlike many blockers, it is designed to make impulsive changes to your settings more difficult.

The Door does not collect any data and does not connect to the internet in any way. 100% local, 100% private.

To learn more, visit the official GitHub page:
github.com/MatheusGHenriques/TheDoor

For screen blocking to work, set your device language to Portuguese or English.
What would you like to control?
Social media, streaming, games, and other apps
Set limits, blocks, or schedules for specific applications
Block access to explicit content on the internet
Block websites and services related to betting
Follow these steps to configure protections according to your goals.

Some banking apps, such as Inter, may flag The Door as a risky app and block access to your account. If this happens, move the banking app to a Secure Folder (Samsung) or a Private Space/Work Profile (other brands). This isolates the banking app from the rest of the system.
Tap DNS > Other DNS > DoH > Cloudflare Family (or CleanBrowsing Family) to block content at the network level.
Routes all traffic through the DNS filter so domain blocking works across all apps.
Cuts internet access if the VPN is disabled, preventing protections from being bypassed.
Prevents newly installed apps from accessing the internet. Configure it in: RethinkDNS > Firewall > Universal Firewall Rules > Block newly installed apps by default.
Install the uBlock Origin extension (ad blocker) in Firefox, along with the BlockNSFW extension (smart adult content blocker).
Open the extension settings, enable Strict Mode, enable Cloudflare Family Ping, and set a PIN that you will not remember to protect these settings.

This step is optional and probably unnecessary if you have already enabled the other protections. Search engines such as Google may display adult content even with Safe Search enabled. It is recommended to block Google and other search engines in the firewall and use only safe.startpage.com. Warning: CleanBrowsing Family blocks Startpage, so both cannot be used together.
Add sites such as bet365, sportingbet, betfair, betano, and stake to the RethinkDNS firewall blocklist. You can do this in: RethinkDNS > Firewall > IP & Port Rules > Domain Rules.
Set daily time limits for each social media app, blocking schedules, and the maximum number of times an app can be opened per day. (This will be configured in the next steps.)
Daily usage limits automatically decrease week by week until reaching your goal. We recommend starting from your current average usage time. (This will be configured in the next steps.)
Block social media and other domains

Completely blocks Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, Reddit, X, and YouTube. To do this, add these domains to the RethinkDNS firewall blocklist. You can do this in: RethinkDNS > Firewall > IP & Port Rules > Domain Rules.
If you configured RethinkDNS, remember to permanently block it in the next steps to prevent configuration changes.
Notifications are required to show the remaining usage time for your apps and to display custom blocking messages.
The Door combines over 30 protection measures that work together to help you regain control of your digital habits.
Make sure you completed all steps. They are necessary to build a robust, secure, and multi-layered protection system.
Tap an app to configure access restrictions or daily usage limits. It is recommended to completely block access to RethinkDNS.
Grant usage access permission in Settings so we can calculate the average daily usage time of your apps.
Completely block access to this app
Block access to the app entirely (it will not be possible to open it) or limit how many times it can be launched per day.
Block the app during specific time windows on selected days. (Example: Block Instagram from 07:00 to 12:00.)

Set daily usage time limits. Usage resets every day. If the Initial value is greater than the Goal, the limit is automatically reduced week by week until reaching the Goal. If the Initial value is equal to or lower than the Goal, the Goal becomes the fixed daily limit for this app.
The Initial value is automatically filled with your average daily usage.
When an app is blocked, The Door can display a custom message, open another app of your choice, or simply return to the home screen.
Displays a custom message when blocking
Example: I would like to have more time to read.
Tip: Write down the reason why you are setting these restrictions. Seeing it when redirected may help you stay focused.
Redirect to a specific app, such as an e-book reader
Simply returns to the home screen
Displays a temporary message on the screen

Select which protections of The Door should remain active. Warning! If all protections are enabled, the only possible ways to remove The Door may be a third-party PIN (may be configured in the next steps), USB commands, or an Android Factory Reset. All protections, usage limits, and restrictions are only enforced after completing the app setup.
Blocks changes to accessibility permissions, which are essential for the application\'s operation.
Keeps Developer Options locked, preventing them from being used to disable the app.
Blocks the App Info screen for all applications, preventing app uninstallation, force stop, data clearing, and disabling device administrator permissions.
Prevents changes to the system language, which could be used to bypass The Door protections.
Blocks adding new apps to Samsung Secure Folder.
Blocks the settings screen that allows installing apps from unknown sources, preventing apps that could bypass protections. Warning: when enabled, updating The Door itself may not be possible.
Prevents Auto Blocker from being turned off, keeping protections against threats and suspicious activity active.

Disables rebooting into Safe Mode, which could allow The Door to be uninstalled. Safe Mode is an Android feature that may still be useful in specific situations. Also locks the screen when the side button settings dialog is opened.
Keeps VPN settings locked, preventing network-level protections from being bypassed.
Prevents changes to Private DNS settings, avoiding domain-blocking bypasses.
Protects Firefox against uninstallation, preventing extensions from being disabled.
Protects RethinkDNS against uninstallation, preventing network-level protections from being disabled.
Blocks changes to Firefox extensions and settings.
Prevents removal of the uBlock Origin extension, which blocks ads and trackers.
Prevents removal of the BlockNSFW extension, which intelligently blocks explicit content.
Confirm that at least The Door Engine, the Accessibility Service, is active. It is essential for the app to function. Some of the other items listed below may not need to be enabled or used.

When attempting to enable the accessibility service, access may be denied. You will need to open the app information page (Device Settings > Apps > The Door), tap the three-dot menu in the upper-right corner, and select "Allow Restricted Settings". Then return to the Accessibility page and enable The Door Engine.

Sets The Door as a Device Administrator. This helps prevent forced uninstallation, app data removal, and reduces the chances of the service being terminated by Android. It does not grant any additional permissions. To enable it, go to: Device Settings > Security & Privacy > More Security Settings > Device Admin Apps, and enable The Door Seal.
Allows the app to notify you about remaining time for daily usage limits and display custom blocking messages.

For advanced users only. Prevents external commands from being executed through USB. It is also recommended to disable Wireless Debugging and enable Auto Blocker (Device Settings > Security & Privacy).
Prevents The Door or its settings from being overwritten by other applications and blocks installation of apps that could bypass protections.
Remove or disable other browsers (such as Chrome and Samsung Internet) that may bypass restrictions, leaving Firefox as the only installed browser.
The preferred browser due to compatibility with extensions that form part of the protection system.
Ad-blocking extension available from the official Firefox Add-ons store.
Smart adult-content blocking extension available from the official Firefox Add-ons store. It should be configured with Strict Mode + Cloudflare Family Ping + a random PIN.
Block domains in RethinkDNS such as google.com, startpage.com, bing.com, etc.
Use safe.startpage.com as the only allowed search engine.
Core application for network-level content control.
Configure Cloudflare Family DoH (or CleanBrowsing Family, which is more aggressive and incompatible with Startpage) and configure the firewall.
Configure maximum daily usage limits, blocking schedules, and how many times an app may be opened.
Add gambling, social media, or other domains to the RethinkDNS firewall. These websites and services will no longer be accessible.

Choose how you want to protect The Door settings. Depending on the protections you previously selected, the only methods that may allow disabling the application will be the third-party PIN (defined below) or an Android Factory Reset (which erases all data on the device). Always keep a backup of your device.
A trusted friend or family member sets a 6-digit PIN that you should never know. This PIN will be required to access The Door settings.
Once configured, the application\'s settings can no longer be modified. Warning! Depending on how you configured The Door, reversing any decision may require an Android Factory Reset.
Hand the phone to another trusted person. They will set a 6-digit PIN that you will not know.
The PIN must contain exactly 6 digits.
The entered PINs do not match.
You will not be able to change The Door settings, usage limits, restrictions, and related configurations. The settings button will be removed.
How can I remove The Door or its protections?
Once activated, the only way to bypass The Door protections may be an Android Factory Reset, which will erase all data on your device. Remember to back up your data.
What if I haven\'t configured everything?
Missing protections may leave ways to bypass restrictions, limits, and blocks. Confirm everything is configured as intended before finalizing and activating The Door.
I understand that reversing this action may require an Android Factory Reset, which will erase all my data.
Settings cannot be modified through the application. Reversal may require an Android Factory Reset.
Enter the 6-digit third-party PIN defined during setup.
Disabling The Door Seal will weaken system-level protection.
This screen is protected. Take a deep breath.
